QuestInfo.name: Request from a Kindergarten Teacher
QuestInfo.0: Raise your Level by helping the townspeople, like the Headmaster suggested.  #b#p2152001#, the Kindergarten Teacher#k, seems to need some help. Go see what he needs.
QuestInfo.1:
A rather odd-looking man, #p2152001#, wants to plant flowers in front of the school, so he asks that you hunt #r#o0150000# enemies#k and bring back #b#t4000595##k items. There's nothing wrong with that, is there? It's for the children, after all!

#i4000595# #t4000595# #b#c4000595#/5#k
QuestInfo.2: You brought the #t4000595# items to #p2152001#, and he told you that the children will be very happy. He really doesn't fit the image of a kindergarten teacher, but he really cares about his kids, which is the important thing.

0.0: (The man gives a huge yawn and then suddenly notices you and scowls.) \r\nYou're #h0#, right? I've heard about you. What do you want? Eh? The Headmaster sent you to help the townspeople? Yeah, I'll take you up on that offer. I have plenty of work.
0.1: Shouldn't be too tough. I want to plant a garden here, to make the place more kid-friendly and the like. Grab me some #b#t4000595#s#k to plant in the garden. Got it?

yes.0: Shouldn't be hard to find some #t4000595#s. Just exit left, hunt some #r#o0150000#s#k, and grab the #t4000595#s they drop. Get me #b5#k. That should be enough to start a garden.

no.0: Bah, you young'uns are so selfish. Think of the children!

1.0:
You got the #t4000595#s, I see. Good. You know, Edelstein's gotten so dark and gloomy lately. This ought to lift the kids' spirits! Children deserve things like that. #h0#, what do you think the children of Edelstein need most these days? 
#L0##bPeace. #l
#L1#Robots!#l
#L2#Nothing.#l

1.1: Yes, yes! Edelstein's so unstable right now. We have to protect our kids from all the turmoil. The sight of beautiful flowers is a start, but I'm sure there's more we can do.

yes.0: You're helping the townspeople as a favor to the Headmaster, right? Then go talk to #b#p2152003##k in front of the #bPolice Station#k. She's a policewoman, but she jumps at the sight of her own shadow.

0.1: Eh, are kids still into robots these days? I didn't know that... But I don't think more toys will really make them happier.
0.2: Bah, kids need loving homes and discipline, not negligence.

item.0: You haven't collected all the #b#t4000595#s#k? Just head toward the #bpark to the left of town#k, hunt #r#o0150000#s#k, and bring me #b5 of the #t4000595#s they drop#k.
